name: EventCreate
description: EventCreate is an event website, registration and ticketing platform for publishing event pages, collecting RSVPs and payments, managing attendees, sending invitations and operating onsite event experiences.
agentUseSummary: EventCreate is visible as a provider-partnership preview. Relay will not request credentials or expose agent actions until EventCreate supplies a supported multi-customer authorization and API contract.

capabilities.label: Access authorized event data
capabilities.description: After EventCreate approves Relay and documents a supported contract, expose only reviewed event capabilities and account fields.

blocked.label: Connect before provider partnership
blocked.description: Relay has not received a supported multi-customer authorization or API contract from EventCreate.

blocked.label: Collect login or session credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not collect an EventCreate password, browser cookie or client session as a substitute for supported provider authorization.

blocked.label: Use undocumented endpoints
blocked.description: Relay will not scrape the dashboard or reverse engineer private event, attendee, registration or payment calls.

blocked.label: Run agent actions before contract review
blocked.description: No read, communication, registration, financial, check-in or administrative action is callable until EventCreate documents the permitted production surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider partnership required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until EventCreate supplies a supported authorization and API contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until EventCreate approves a supported production integration.
No Hermes tools are callable until EventCreate approves a supported production integration.

providerSetup.blocker: EventCreate publicly advertises prebuilt integrations, Zapier and an invitation to request a custom integration, but does not publish the authentication, endpoints, schemas, permissions, rate limits, lifecycle or distribution terms required for a Relay connector.
providerSetup.nextAction: Contact EventCreate through its official custom-integration channel and request a written multi-customer authorization and API contract. Review scopes, tenant binding, data fields, limits, revocation and third-party terms before implementing bounded tools.

evidence.supports: EventCreate advertises prebuilt Mailchimp, Salesforce, Zapier and other integrations and asks customers to contact it for custom integrations, without publishing a general account API contract.
EventCreate's current official help center documents product workflows and specific integrations but does not expose a public developer API, OAuth application or customer API-key lifecycle.
EventCreate documents role-based dashboard authority over events, communications, financial data and check-in, reinforcing the need for an explicit scoped integration contract.
